name: Codebase Graph Retrieval
description: Indexes a source repository into a graph of prose code nodes and call/reference edges, then retrieves the relevant nodes with exact file:line spans into an agent's context so it can locate code, trace callers, and scope an edit's blast radius without reading raw source.

timeline.details: Created generic fusion node 'codebase-graph-retrieval' via `gaia dev fuse`.
Set prerequisites via `gaia dev fuse`: knowledge-graph-build, retrieve, context-compression.
